typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	savenewlistoforigins_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Origin as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> getnewlistofOrigins
getnewlistofOrigins sink(input(
		Origin as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Origin),
	partitionFileNames:[($savenewlistoforigins_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> savenewlistoforigins
